chain_handoff_format_v1.4.design_philosophy: Rapid execution tracking focused on speed optimization and delivery performance

velocity_core.description: Core speed and timing metrics for rapid execution tracking

design_time_seconds.description: Total time spent designing the chain (target: <120 seconds)

pattern_selection_time.description: Time to select and apply pattern template (target: <30 seconds)

customization_time.description: Time spent customizing the selected pattern (target: <45 seconds)

total_chain_duration_minutes.description: Estimated total execution time for the chain

speed_optimization_score.description: Overall speed optimization rating (10 = maximum speed achieved)

pattern_execution.description: Template and pattern performance data for speed optimization

selected_pattern.description: Core pattern used from speed-optimized library

pattern_confidence.description: Confidence in pattern selection (only high/medium used for speed)

template_customizations.description: List of essential customizations made to base template

heuristic_decisions.description: Quick decisions made using heuristics vs full analysis

fallback_usage.description: Whether emergency simple pattern was used as fallback

execution_efficiency.description: Resource utilization and parallel execution optimization data

speed_vs_quality_balance.description: Trade-offs made prioritizing speed over exhaustive optimization

good_enough_decisions.description: Decisions where 'good enough' was chosen over perfect

recovery_performance.description: Error handling and adaptation speed metrics

resilience_score.description: How quickly chain adapts to unexpected conditions

delivery_impact.description: User-facing results and satisfaction with speed-first approach

optimization_insights.description: Lessons learned for improving future speed optimization

template_enhancement_opportunities.description: Ways to make templates even faster to apply

handoff_execution_data.description: Specific data for agent execution and coordination

design_rationale.speed_first_philosophy: Every field directly supports faster chain design and execution
design_rationale.actionable_metrics: All data points inform concrete speed optimization decisions
design_rationale.heuristic_emphasis: Tracks where quick decisions outperformed exhaustive analysis
design_rationale.template_performance: Focuses on pattern effectiveness for rapid deployment
design_rationale.user_value_focus: Prioritizes delivery speed and user satisfaction over theoretical optimization
design_rationale.recovery_speed: Emphasizes rapid adaptation over comprehensive error analysis
design_rationale.continuous_improvement: Structured to drive faster iterations in future chain designs

usage_guidelines.when_to_use: All Chain Engineer v1.4 handoffs requiring speed optimization tracking
usage_guidelines.completion_time_target: Format should be filled in <60 seconds post-execution
usage_guidelines.focus_areas: Prioritize velocity_core, pattern_execution, and delivery_impact sections
usage_guidelines.optimization_cycle: Use optimization_insights to improve next chain design speed
usage_guidelines.quality_threshold: Accept 'good enough' data over perfect measurements for speed
